package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestZZGzipEmpty(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c := e.NewContext(req, rec)
	h := Gzip()(func(c echo.Context) error {
		return nil
	})
	if assert.NoError(t, h(c)) {
		t.Logf("CE=%q CT=%q body=%q code=%d", rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType), rec.Body.String(), rec.Code)
		assert.Empty(t, rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding))
		assert.Empty(t, rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType))
		assert.Equal(t, 0, len(rec.Body.Bytes()))
	}
}

func TestZZGzipEmptyViaEcho(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	e.Use(Gzip())
	e.GET("/", func(c echo.Context) error { return nil })
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	t.Logf("CE=%q CT=%q body=%q code=%d", rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType), rec.Body.String(), rec.Code)
	assert.Empty(t, rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding))
	assert.Equal(t, 0, len(rec.Body.Bytes()))
}

func TestZZGzipEmptyWriteEmpty(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	e.Use(Gzip())
	e.GET("/", func(c echo.Context) error {
		return c.String(http.StatusOK, "")
	})
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	t.Logf("CE=%q CT=%q body=%q code=%d", rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType), rec.Body.String(), rec.Code)
}
EOF

package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
)

func run(t *testing.T, name string, h echo.HandlerFunc) {
	e := echo.New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c := e.NewContext(req, rec)
	mw := Gzip()(h)
	err := mw(c)
	t.Logf("%s: err=%v CE=%q CT=%q bodyLen=%d body=%q code=%d", name, err, rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType), rec.Body.Len(), rec.Body.String(), rec.Code)
}

func TestZZGzipVariants(t *testing.T) {
	run(t, "nothing", func(c echo.Context) error { return nil })
	run(t, "write-empty-slice", func(c echo.Context) error { c.Response().Write([]byte{}); return nil })
	run(t, "string-empty", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.String(http.StatusOK, "") })
	run(t, "nocontent200", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.NoContent(http.StatusOK) })
	run(t, "nocontent204", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.NoContent(http.StatusNoContent) })
	run(t, "err-after-nothing", func(c echo.Context) error { return echo.ErrNotFound })
	run(t, "json-empty-map", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.JSON(http.StatusOK, map[string]string{}) })
}
EOF
